'''Vanden Willard''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[General/Legends|General]] and tactical advisor who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|When we heard about Alderaan, we were afraid that you were... lost along with your father.|Vanden Willard|<ref name="ANH novel">[[Star Wars: A New Hope (novelization)|''Star Wars Episode IV: A New Hope'' novel]]</ref>}}
A native of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Willard was an old friend of [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]], and served as a spy for the [[House of Organa/Legends|Organa family]]. During his career, he served as commander of [[Delta Base]] on the remote [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[New Kisge]] in the [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]].

[[File:VandenWillard.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Willard on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].]]

Willard joined the Alliance forces at the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi base]] [[0 BBY/Legends|six months]] prior to the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|first Death Star's]] arrival. [[General/Legends|General]] [[Jan Dodonna/Legends|Jan Dodonna]] assigned Willard, now an Alliance general, to command [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4's]] planetary defenses. Willard was speaking with Bail Organa through a secure [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]] channel when Alderaan was destroyed. Willard feared that [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] had perished, and was elated when she arrived at Yavin 4 with the [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the Death Star.<ref name="Episode IV" /> When the Death Star arrived in the [[Yavin system/Legends|Yavin system]], Willard began devising an evacuation plan after assisting Dodonna with the development of an attack plan against the [[Space station/Legends|space station]].

Willard was consulted with [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] successful flight simulator results prior to the battle, and supported Skywalker joining [[Red Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Red Squadron]].<ref name="SWJ">''[[Star Wars Journal: The Fight for Justice]]''</ref>

After the Alliance [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|victory at Yavin]], Willard coordinated the [[Battle of Shaylin 18]], and then was assigned the command of [[Delta Base]] and of [[Suolriep sector/Legends|Suolriep sector]]. During this time, Willard was sent in missions with young tactics prodigy [[Risiev Credal]]. Alongside with Dodonna, Willard and Credal spent free time discussing the tactics used in Yavin. After Credal's disappearance and presumable desertion, Willard still could not believe him a traitor, but accepted the possibility.

[[File:Willard.jpg|thumb|right|200px|Vanden Willard]]
During his service on Delta Base, Willard worked with the [[Task Force on Alliance Security]], writing reports on threats to the Alliance. He wrote a report on assassin [[Callandri]] specifying her first attack on lieutenant [[Alton Lochner]].<ref name="air">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]''</ref>

Willard retired for active military duty to train officers, captains, and pilots in the vagaries of military strategy, space combat, and tactical decision-making. He is remembered with particular bitterness by starfighter pilots who faced the [[Redemption scenario|''Redemption'' scenario]], a particularly difficult simulation designed by Willard.

As the New Republic formed, Willard worked with fellow strategic luminaries Dodonna, [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], and [[Pashna Starkiller]]. The work of the "[[Gray Cadre/Legends|Gray Cadre]]" was essential in developing the strategic and tactical methods that would assist the New Republic in defeating enemies like the cloned [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Rebellion_vanden_willard.png|thumb|left|200px|Incorrect image of Vanden Willard from ''Star Wars: Rebellion'']]
Willard was played by Irish actor [[Eddie Byrne]] in [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''A New Hope'']]. His voice was dubbed by [[Michael Bell]].<ref name="Homing Beacon">''[[Homing Beacon (newsletter)|The Homing Beacon]] #260</ref> The character was named after screenwriter [[Willard Huyck]], who, along with his wife [[Gloria Katz]], helped [[George Lucas]] put some finishing touches on the revised fourth draft of the movie's script. While the [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game|''CCG'']] accurately identifies Willard (as played by Byrne), other sources, such as [[Star Wars: Rebellion (video game)|''Star Wars: Rebellion'']] and ''[[Star Wars: Rebellion: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', have confused Byrne's Willard with the mustachioed General [[Bob Hudsol/Legends|Bob Hudsol]].
